name: cRZUnknownList::Construct
notes: Hooked (lane FC, standalone shape): cRZUnknownListAdapters::Construct builds our class on the caller's memory. cRZUnknownList_Adapters: words of both constructed lists compared (empty ring, count 0), the table word (the original's stores the game vtable 0xda3008, ours our class's), nothing written past 0x10 bytes. Slots test: the same table check, plus every slot through our own vtable on lists it built. Mutants killed through the slots test: Release threshold, QueryInterface id.

notes: Hooked (lane FC): the non-deleting destructor, called inline by 0x428dc0 and by the deleting destructor. cRZUnknownList_Adapters: lists of 0 to 5 elements on an object with a trap vtable; the elements' Release log, the free count of the call and the word left at +0 compared with the original's; no trap hit.

notes: Hooked (lane FC): 0x428dc0 calls it directly, so the adapter stays. cRZUnknownList_Adapters: result, the element's AddRef/Release traffic, the ring's words and the elements' counts compared on an object carrying a trap vtable (a virtual dispatch on this lands in a trap). Also called through our vtable in the slots test. Mutant killed: the adapter dispatching virtually.

name: cRZUnknownList::QueryInterface (slot 0)
notes: Standalone shape (lane FC): ours through our vtable; the original only in the game's vtable 0xda3008. cRZUnknownList_Slots: 100+ ids (0, 1, 0x12e, their bit flips, random): result, the out pointer (self or untouched), the count after. Mutant killed: id 1 dropped.

name: cRZUnknownList::Release (slot 2)
notes: Standalone shape (lane FC). cRZUnknownList_Slots: counts 0, 1, 2, 3, 0x80000000, 0xffffffff on lists holding two elements: result, freed or not (FreeRecorder), the survivor's state, the elements' counts; and the list's deletion at the end of every sequence. Mutant killed: threshold 2 (double delete).
